notes: Requires a Gezel build with Iris defaults and stable-diffusion.cpp master-951-f89d9b1 or newer. Original F32 image weights are loaded in BF16; the Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct Q4_K_M text encoder keeps its quantization. Use CFG 3, Euler, diffusion flash attention, and dimensions divisible by 16 at approximately one megapixel. The publisher recommends 100 steps; a completed 20-step Gezel smoke test at 1024x1024 took 174 seconds on a 128 GB Apple M5 Max, with about 11.8 GB peak resident memory. The full 100-step recommendation was not benchmarked to completion. The 32 GB memory recommendation is conservative, not a measured minimum; other backends are unverified. Captions are limited to 300 tokens including the assistant-turn suffix. No VAE or vision projector is needed. Text-to-image only: depth estimation and restoration/upscaling require separate checkpoints and are not included.
